verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services company with a case-preparation platform. A product like this could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows natural-language command operation: the platform is described only as document upload and readiness tracking, the eligibility checks are structured questionnaires, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
